full_inspection: All four complete native images of copy1site049 and copy2site125 were inspected. Every body line, punctuation mark, underline and margin was compared. The interlinear les with its placement stroke and the differing archive foliations are the observed manuscript loci; the remaining body readings agree.
original_transcription_comparison: Both original transcriptions were compared in full. The insertion and foliation differences were confirmed visually. The differing source quote syntax around dynamique refers to the same paired upright marks in the two images and is explicitly recorded as an encoding difference.

entries.decision: record the encoding difference with identical observed quotation marks
entries.reason: Both images show the same double upright quotation strokes before and after dynamique. The two source encodings are preserved; this row records their literal difference without asserting a difference in the impressions.

entries.decision: retain the interlinear insertion in copy2
entries.reason: The handwritten les and its curved placement stroke are clear above the gap between et and plus. Copy1 has no insertion.
The lower-left inscriptions clearly read49 and125. No authorship attribution is made.
